# DebugLog <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DebugLog:Void text:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | In | String | required | The text to log. |

## Description

Writes a line to the debug log. A program started from a terminal shows it on the standard error output, so it does not mix with what `Print` writes. On Windows programs have no console window of their own, they print into the terminal they were started from and the line is also sent to an attached debugger. See [Console window on Windows](Installation#console-window-on-windows) for how to get a console.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
DebugLog "player is at 10, 20"
```
